### Funciones independientes:

#### `def register(viewer, order)` (Línea 29)
- **Propósito:** The :py:func:`register` function is used to register additional viewers::

    from PIL import ImageShow
    ImageShow.register(MyViewer())  # MyViewer will be used as a last resort
    ImageShow.register(MySecondViewer(), 0)  # MySecondViewer will be prioritised
    ImageShow.register(ImageShow.XVViewer(), 0)  # XVViewer will be prioritised

:param viewer: The viewer to be registered.
:param order:
    Zero or a negative integer to prepend this viewer to the list,
    a positive integer to append it.
- **Firma:** `def register(viewer, order)`
- **Retorno / Efectos:** Consulta código fuente.

#### `def show(image, title)` (Línea 51)
- **Propósito:** Display a given image.

:param image: An image object.
:param title: Optional title. Not all viewers can display the title.
:param \**options: Additional viewer options.
:returns: ``True`` if a suitable viewer was found, ``False`` otherwise.
- **Firma:** `def show(image, title)`
